thread:
sophie: Hey team — opened a docs PR to add the new Vega13b quantized variant and clarify long-context limits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/9845 :link:
kevin: looking now. main things to check: sample SDK snippet, the seq_len number, and the bench link that used to point to the old bucket :eyes:
maria: thx. I noticed the model variant name in the PR is `vega13b-q4_0` — we usually use `-q4_0` suffix but some cards use `-quant`. we should standardize. pinging @alex for naming preference
alex: prefer `-q4_0` (explicit quantization). less ambiguity for toolchain. update the PR to use that label pls.
sophie: will change. also updating the limits section to call out "max_context_tokens: 32768" and include a short note about degraded perf for >16k tokens
chris: can we add a small benchmark table? current PR references a Google Sheet that isn't public. can we embed the key numbers inline: latency p50/p95 for 512/2048/8192 tokens?
maria: I have the CSV from perf-team. suggested snippet to paste (short):
```
Benchmarks (Vega13b-q4_0, 1xA100):
- 512 tokens: p50 45ms, p95 120ms
- 2048 tokens: p50 160ms, p95 360ms
- 8192 tokens: p50 750ms, p95 1450ms
```
kevin: looks good. make sure to mark these as "approx" and add the measurement config (batch size=1, temperature=0.7, greedy).
sophie: added measurement config and approx flag in new commit. also fixed the folder link that pointed to `old-bench-bucket` -> `gs://redwood-perf/vega13b/2026-03`.
maria: small doc nit: the SDK example still shows the old `client.generate()` signature. we migrated to `client.text.generate()` in SDK v4.0. should include both old -> new migration snippet.
sophie: added migration snippet. here's the new minimal example I put in the PR:
```
# SDK v4 - Python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.text.generate(model="vega13b-q4_0", input="Summarize: ...")
print(resp.output_text)
```
kevin: nice. add a one-liner for Node too.
chris: also add a short note about compatibility: quantized variant doesn't support CPU fallback on small instances. we should call that out under "compatibility" so Customer Success doesn't get surprised.
sophie: added compatibility note: "No CPU-only fallback; use dedicated or hosted GPU. For on-prem CPU fallback see `vega13b-bf16` variant."
alex: one more link fix: the model-card cross-ref to `sequence-limits.md` used a relative anchor that changed after the reorg. replace `#context-window` with `#sequence-length-limits`
sophie: fixed the anchor and rebased.
maria: do we want a quick code sample for prefix caching? many users ask how to enable it and it's relevant for long context.
kevin: keep it short — one curl example is fine.
sophie: added curl snippet under "performance tips":
```
# enable prefix caching via route config
POST /v1/routes/my-route/config
{
  "prefix_cache": true,
  "max_cached_tokens": 8192
}
```
julie: QA note: please add a link to the internal perf dashboard (read-only) so support can validate numbers. put it under "benchmarks" with a note "internal-only".
sophie: added internal link and flagged it internal-only. also left the public CSV link for external readers.
kevin: PR LGTM after the naming change and small text tweaks. :shipit:
docs-bot: Deployment queued: site rebuild for model-catalog. Estimated publish: 10m.
maria: awesome — will skim after publish and create a short tweet/announcement for the docs changelog.
sophie: thanks everyone — merging in 5 if no blockers.
kevin: no blockers from me.
chris: good to go.
sophie: merged and closing the loop. :tada:
